pathways.name: SAMADHAN 2.0
pathways.description: The Ministry of Labour and Employment's SAMADHAN portal provides a channel for specified employment-related claims and industrial disputes.
pathways.why_relevant: Your report may involve unpaid wages or another employment-related claim covered by the portal.
pathways.eligibility: The worker must check the applicable claim category, jurisdiction and filing requirements.

pathways.name: Telangana Labour Department
pathways.description: The Labour Department handles labour-law enforcement, labour disputes, conciliation and worker welfare.
pathways.why_relevant: Your report may involve a labour dispute or a workplace condition covered by labour laws.
pathways.eligibility: The applicable process depends on the worker's employment situation, establishment and jurisdiction.

pathways.name: Directorate of Factories, Telangana
pathways.description: The Directorate of Factories is a potential route for safety and compliance issues in establishments under its jurisdiction.
pathways.why_relevant: Your workplace may fall under factory safety regulation.
pathways.eligibility: Applicability depends on the type and legal classification of the establishment.

pathways.name: Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
pathways.description: Construction worker registration and welfare benefits may be available through the state welfare board.
pathways.why_relevant: You reported construction work and may need information about worker registration or welfare benefits.
pathways.eligibility: Registration, work history and scheme-specific conditions must be checked.

pathways.name: Telangana Police
pathways.description: Police may receive complaints about suspected offences and provide emergency protection.
pathways.why_relevant: Your report describes possible violence, threats, confinement, forced labour or another offence.
pathways.eligibility: The facts and applicable law determine the appropriate police process.

pathways.name: Telangana Police Women Safety Wing
pathways.description: The Women Safety Wing provides support and referrals for women and children facing violence and exploitation.
pathways.why_relevant: Your report may involve violence or exploitation affecting a woman or child.
pathways.eligibility: The appropriate service depends on the type of incident. The Women Safety Wing states that it does not directly accept sexual-harassment complaints.

pathways.name: District Legal Services Authority
pathways.description: Provides access to legal advice and free legal services for eligible applicants.
pathways.why_relevant: You may be able to receive legal guidance before preparing or submitting a complaint.
pathways.eligibility: Eligibility is assessed under the Legal Services Authorities Act and applicable rules.

pathways.name: Telangana Prajavani
pathways.description: A government grievance redressal channel for public-service and administrative grievances.
pathways.why_relevant: Your complaint concerns a government department or public service.
pathways.eligibility: Use the relevant department's specialised complaint process where one applies.

pathways.name: EPFO Grievance Management System
pathways.description: Handles grievances related to provident fund services.
pathways.why_relevant: Your report concerns PF contributions, account services or an EPFO matter.
pathways.eligibility: Relevant membership or establishment details may be required.

pathways.name: AASHRAY
pathways.description: Potential support for migrant workers, safe migration, documentation, social-security access and grievance guidance.

pathways.name: Montfort Social Institute
pathways.description: Potential support for worker collectives, rights awareness and access to social-security entitlements.

pathways.name: Association for Promoting Social Action (APSA)
pathways.description: Potential community-based support and rights-awareness assistance for marginalised workers.

pathways.name: Don Bosco for Migrants
pathways.description: Potential migrant-worker assistance, safe-migration guidance and referrals for legal aid and welfare support.

pathways.name: Human Rights Law Network (HRLN)
pathways.description: Potential legal guidance for human-rights and labour-related matters. Local case intake and representation must be confirmed.

pathways.name: Migrant Resource Centre Hyderabad
pathways.description: Potential migrant-worker support resource. Operating organisation, current services and contact details must be verified.
